title: ragr-eval — golden test set
description: How does the pipeline score on the curated questions with known answers? One point per run of the golden test set.

target.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT h.created_at AS t, m.filename,
         CASE WHEN lag(h.created_at) OVER (ORDER BY h.created_at) IS NULL
                OR h.created_at - lag(h.created_at) OVER (ORDER BY h.created_at) > interval '10 minutes'
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts
  FROM public.document_metadata_history h
  LEFT JOIN public.document_metadata m ON m.id = h.document_metadata_id
  WHERE h.status = 'INDEXED' AND $__timeFilter(h.created_at)
), b AS (SELECT t, filename, sum(starts) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS batch FROM h)
SELECT min(t) AS "time", max(t) AS "timeEnd",
       CASE WHEN count(*) = 1 THEN 'Indexed ' || COALESCE(min(filename), 'a document since deleted')
            ELSE 'Indexed ' || count(*) || ' documents' END AS "text",
       'ingest' AS "tags"
FROM b GROUP BY batch ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.started_at AS "time", 'Golden run ' || e.passed_count || '/' || e.case_count || CASE WHEN e.judged THEN ' (judged)' ELSE '' END AS "text", 'golden' AS "tags" FROM eval.eval_run e WHERE e.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(e.started_at)

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: How long ago the golden test set last ran. Every number below comes from that run, however old. It runs only when started by hand: ./mvnw test -pl ragr-eval -am -Dsurefire.excludedGroups= -Dtest=EvalSuiteIT

panels.title: Latest run
panels.description: Cases passed: cases that met every check the test set states. Judged correct: the judge's verdict, from the latest run that ran the judge. Example target: End-to-end success above 0.7.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.passed_count::float / NULLIF(e.case_count, 0) AS "Cases passed (Case pass rate)", (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.answer_ok THEN 0.0 END) FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.run_id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND judged ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "Judged correct (End-to-end success)", e.case_count AS "Cases", (SELECT AVG(r.latency_millis) FROM eval.eval_case_result r WHERE r.run_id = e.id) AS "Average answer time" FROM eval.eval_run e WHERE e.id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT e.started_at AS "time", e.passed_count::float / NULLIF(e.case_count, 0) AS "Cases passed (Case pass rate)", (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.answer_ok THEN 0.0 END) FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.run_id = e.id) AS "Judged correct (End-to-end success)" FROM eval.eval_run e WHERE e.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(e.started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Retrieval - did the search find the right pages? (Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR, NDCG)
Search quality (Retrieval metrics) - latest run
panels.description: Scored against the pages each case lists as holding the answer. Expected pages used: share of them that reached the prompt. Prompt that was useful: share of the prompt from those pages - a floor, since other pages can help too. Expected page on top (MRR): 1 when the first passage is from one, 1/2 when the second is, and so on. Ranking quality (NDCG): like MRR, but counts every useful passage, weighted by how high it sits. Any expected page used: share of cases with at least one. Example targets: Recall above 0.8, Precision and MRR above 0.6, NDCG above 0.7.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.recall_at_k AS "Expected pages used (Recall@K)", e.precision_at_k AS "Prompt that was useful (Precision@K)", e.mean_reciprocal_rank AS "Expected page on top (MRR)", e.ndcg_at_k AS "Ranking quality (NDCG@K)", e.hit_rate AS "Any expected page used (Hit rate)", e.case_count AS "Cases" FROM eval.eval_run e WHERE e.id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT e.started_at AS "time", e.recall_at_k AS "Expected pages used (Recall@K)", e.precision_at_k AS "Prompt that was useful (Precision@K)", e.mean_reciprocal_rank AS "Expected page on top (MRR)", e.ndcg_at_k AS "Ranking quality (NDCG@K)", e.hit_rate AS "Any expected page used (Hit rate)" FROM eval.eval_run e WHERE e.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(e.started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Generation - is the answer itself good? (Faithfulness, Answer relevance, Completeness, Citation correctness)
Answer quality (Generation metrics) - latest run
panels.description: Judge scores come from the latest run that ran the judge; the citation check from the latest run of any kind. Backed by sources: share of the answer's statements the passages support. Citations check out: cited pages that really say what the sentence claims. Citations to shown pages: cited pages that were in the prompt. Example targets: Faithfulness and Citation support above 0.8.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(t.faithfulness) AS "Backed by sources (Faithfulness)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.relevancy_pass THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.relevancy_pass THEN 0.0 END) AS "On topic (Answer relevance)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.completeness_pass THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.completeness_pass THEN 0.0 END) AS "Complete (Completeness)", SUM(t.citations_supported)::float / NULLIF(SUM(t.citations_checked), 0) AS "Citations check out (Citation support)", (SELECT citation_validity FROM eval.eval_run WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "Citations to shown pages (Citation validity)", COUNT(t.faithfulness) AS "Answers judged" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.run_id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND judged ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND t.grounded

panels.title: Answer quality per run (Generation metrics)
panels.description: One point per run; judge scores only on runs that ran the judge. Key phrases present: share of each case's required phrases found in the answer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.started_at AS "time", (SELECT AVG(t.faithfulness) FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.run_id = e.id AND t.grounded) AS "Backed by sources (Faithfulness)", e.relevancy_rate AS "On topic (Answer relevance)", e.citation_validity AS "Citations to shown pages (Citation validity)", e.citation_fabrication AS "Made-up citations (Citation fabrication)", e.phrase_coverage AS "Key phrases present (Phrase coverage)" FROM eval.eval_run e WHERE e.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(e.started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: End to end - did the whole pipeline work? (End-to-end accuracy, Task-based metrics)
Where answers go wrong (RAG debugging matrix) - latest judged run
panels.description: Each judged case placed by two verdicts: did a useful passage reach the prompt, and was the answer correct. The diagnosis says which part to fix.

targets.rawSql: SELECT q.quadrant AS "passages × answer", COUNT(t.turn_id) AS "turns", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(t.turn_id) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(t.turn_id)) OVER (), 0), 0) AS "%", q.diagnosis FROM (VALUES (1, true, true, 'right × right', 'Working well'), (2, true, false, 'right × wrong', 'Generation problem - fix prompt, model or context handling'), (3, false, true, 'wrong × right', 'Partial retrieval, or the judge is wrong'), (4, false, false, 'wrong × wrong', 'Retrieval problem - fix the retriever first')) AS q(ord, r, a, quadrant, diagnosis) LEFT JOIN eval.eval_turn t ON t.retrieval_ok = q.r AND t.answer_ok = q.a AND t.run_id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND judged ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY q.ord, q.quadrant, q.diagnosis ORDER BY q.ord

panels.title: By kind of question (Task-based metrics) - latest judged run
panels.description: The main measures split by the kind of question the classifier assigned. The test set has no troubleshooting case yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(t.task_type, 'unclassified') AS "task", COUNT(*) AS "turns", ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN t.grounded THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.grounded THEN 0.0 END), 0) AS "passages found % (retrieved)", ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.answer_ok THEN 0.0 END), 0) AS "judged correct % (e2e success)", ROUND(AVG(t.faithfulness)::numeric, 2) AS "backed by sources (faithfulness)", ROUND(AVG(t.recall_at_k)::numeric, 2) AS "useful passages used (recall@k)", ROUND(AVG(t.ndcg_at_k)::numeric, 2) AS "ranking quality (NDCG)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.run_id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND judged ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Can we trust the judge? (Judge calibration)
Does the judge spot the right passages?
panels.description: Every passage of the latest judged run: the judge's "useful" compared with the hand-checked list of pages that hold each answer. The live search scores rest on this. The checklist marks whole pages, so some "checklist said useful" passages are a listed page's unhelpful parts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN (c.judge_grade >= 2) = (r.v = '1') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Agrees with the checklist (Judge-reference agreement)", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.judge_grade >= 2 AND r.v = '0') AS "Judge said useful, checklist didn't", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.judge_grade < 2 AND r.v = '1') AS "Checklist said useful, judge didn't", COUNT(*) AS "Passages compared" FROM eval.eval_case_result cr JOIN eval.eval_turn_chunk c ON c.turn_id = cr.turn_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT u.v FROM unnest(string_to_array(cr.reference_relevance, ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v, ord) WHERE u.ord = c.rank) r WHERE cr.run_id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND judged ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND c.judge_grade IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Cases in the latest run
panels.description: Every case of the most recent run, failures first, with the reason. Empty judge columns mean the run did not run the judge, not that the case failed. The full answer is in eval.eval_case_result.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.case_id AS "case", r.passed, r.failure_reasons AS "why it failed", r.query, r.retrieved_count AS "passages", r.first_relevant_rank AS "rank of expected page", r.citations_emitted AS "citations", r.citations_fabricated AS "made up", ROUND((r.phrase_coverage * 100)::numeric, 0) AS "key phrases % (phrase coverage)", r.relevancy_pass AS "on topic (answer relevance)", LEFT(r.answer, 160) AS "answer (truncated)", r.latency_millis AS "ms" FROM eval.eval_case_result r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT id FROM eval.eval_run ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY r.passed ASC, r.citations_fabricated DESC, r.case_id

panels.title: Pass history by case (Flaky cases)
panels.description: How each case behaved across runs. A case that flips between pass and fail with no pipeline change is flaky: loosen it or remove it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.case_id AS "case", COUNT(*) AS "runs", SUM(CASE WHEN r.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "passed", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.passed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::numeric, 2) AS "pass rate", SUM(r.citations_fabricated) AS "made-up citations (citation fabrication)", ROUND(AVG(r.first_relevant_rank)::numeric, 2) AS "avg rank of expected page", ROUND(AVG(r.latency_millis)::numeric, 0) AS "avg ms" FROM eval.eval_case_result r GROUP BY r.case_id ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN r.passed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) ASC, r.case_id

panels.title: Run history
panels.description: Every run and the settings that produced it. Compare scores only between runs with the same models, top-k and threshold, and no re-ingest in between (marked on the time axis). A run stuck in RUNNING was stopped partway.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.started_at AS "started", e.suite, e.status, e.passed_count || '/' || e.case_count AS "passed", ROUND(e.recall_at_k::numeric, 3) AS "expected pages used (recall@k)", ROUND(e.mean_reciprocal_rank::numeric, 3) AS "expected page on top (MRR)", ROUND(e.ndcg_at_k::numeric, 3) AS "ranking quality (NDCG)", ROUND(e.hit_rate::numeric, 3) AS "any expected page used (hit rate)", ROUND(e.citation_validity::numeric, 3) AS "citations to shown pages (citation validity)", ROUND(e.citation_fabrication::numeric, 3) AS "made-up citations (citation fabrication)", e.chat_model AS "chat model", CASE WHEN e.judged THEN e.judge_model ELSE 'not judged' END AS "judge", e.top_k AS "top-k", e.similarity_threshold AS "threshold", e.duration_millis AS "ms" FROM eval.eval_run e ORDER BY e.started_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Useful passages ranked first (Context precision)
panels.description: Whether the useful passages sat at the top of the prompt (RAGAS context precision). It rewards order, not quantity: one useful passage in first place scores 1.0. Measured against the expected pages (a floor), by the judge (judged runs only), and by what the answer cited. Compare between runs.

panels.title: Share of the prompt that was useful (Precision@K)
panels.description: Useful passages over passages in the prompt, measured the same three ways. Low here with a high score beside it means well ordered but mostly filler: lower top-k or raise the threshold.
